_note: Classes for the soil, tree and general leaf-disease domains. 'description' is what Qwen reads when labeling; 'queries' are web searches used by collect_web.py. Edit freely: add a class, retrain. Class names must be unique across ALL domains (including plant/ classes from PlantVillage).

soil_dark_loam.description: Dark brown to black crumbly soil with small clumps, visible roots or organic bits; looks moist and healthy.

soil_sandy.description: Light, loose, gritty soil with visible individual sand grains; does not clump.

soil_clay_cracked.description: Dry clay soil with a network of deep cracks or polygon-shaped plates.

soil_waterlogged.description: Soil covered or saturated with standing water or puddles in a field or bed.

soil_eroded.description: Soil with gullies, rills, washed-out channels or exposed subsoil from water or wind erosion.

soil_surface_crust.description: Flat, hard, smooth surface crust on bare soil after rain, sometimes with thin flakes peeling up.

soil_salt_crust.description: White or grayish salt deposits or crust on the soil surface.

tree_healthy.description: A tree, branch or leaves with full green foliage and no visible damage, spots or dead parts.

tree_leaf_spots.description: Tree leaves with brown, black or tan spots, blotches or lesions.

tree_yellowing_leaves.description: Tree leaves that are yellow or pale between green veins out of season (chlorosis), not autumn color.

tree_dieback.description: Thin crown or dead, bare branches at the top or ends of an otherwise living tree.

tree_bark_canker.description: Bark with sunken lesions, cracks, oozing sap or dead patches on the trunk or branches.

tree_fungal_conk.description: Shelf mushrooms, brackets or conks growing on a trunk, root flare or branch.

tree_insect_damage.description: Signs of insects on a tree: borer exit holes, sawdust frass, galleries under bark, chewed or skeletonized leaves, webbing.

tree_dead.description: A whole tree that is dead: no live leaves in the growing season, brown or gray needles, peeling bark.

leaf._note: General symptoms for crops NOT covered by the plant/ classes (PlantVillage/PlantDoc crops).

leaf_powdery_mildew.description: White or gray powdery coating on leaf surfaces.

leaf_rust.description: Orange, rust-colored or brown raised pustules on leaves.

leaf_spot_general.description: Round or angular brown, black or yellow-ringed spots scattered on leaves.

leaf_mosaic_virus.description: Mottled light and dark green or yellow mosaic pattern, often with curled or distorted leaves.

leaf_wilting.description: Drooping, limp or collapsed leaves and stems.

leaf_nutrient_yellowing.description: Leaves turning yellow or pale, evenly or between veins, often older leaves first; no spots.

leaf_insect_damage.description: Holes chewed in leaves, leaf miner trails, or visible aphids, beetles or caterpillars on leaves.

leaf_healthy_other.description: Healthy green leaves of a crop or garden plant with no spots, discoloration or damage.
